scope: Targeted screen of football and basketball leadership changes and main-conference changes; not an exhaustive coaching census across every sport. No identified change is not evidence of no change.

schools.coaching_change: Chris Petersen stepped down and Jimmy Lake was named football head coach in December 2019, within the case window.
schools.realignment_note: No main-conference change in the observed 2017-18 through 2021-22 case seasons. Later Big Ten move is outside this window.

schools.coaching_change: Earl Grant was named men's basketball head coach in March 2021, shortly before the provider transition.
schools.realignment_note: No main-conference change in the available case seasons.

schools.coaching_change: Tim Bergstraser was named men's basketball head coach on April 14, 2025; his first season was 2025-26.
schools.realignment_note: Summit League throughout observed case seasons. A 2026-27 West Coast Conference move is noted by the official coach biography but falls beyond the available outcomes.

schools.coaching_change: Mark Madsen was named men's basketball head coach in March 2023, before the 2023-24 Nike season.
schools.realignment_note: Pac-12 to ACC in 2024-25; official ACC membership began August 2, 2024, within the post-switch window.

schools.coaching_change: The targeted source documents Coquese Washington's women's basketball appointment in May 2022, outside this 2023-24 through 2027-28 window. No claim that all coaching staffs were unchanged.
schools.realignment_note: No main-conference change in the available case seasons.

schools.coaching_change: Mick Cronin was hired as men's basketball head coach in April 2019; his first season was the excluded 2019-20 season at the start of this case window.
schools.realignment_note: Pac-12 throughout the observed case window, which ends in 2023-24. The subsequent 2024-25 Big Ten move is outside the window.

schools.coaching_change: Scott Satterfield was named football head coach in December 2022 and began the 2023 season during the provider and conference changes.
schools.realignment_note: American Athletic Conference to Big 12 on July 1, 2023, coincident with the Nike transition.

schools.coaching_change: Steven Pearl was named men's basketball head coach in September 2025 during the first Nike season.
schools.realignment_note: No main-conference change in the available case seasons.

schools.coaching_change: Grant McCasland was named men's basketball head coach in March 2023 and began in 2023-24, within the pre-switch window.
schools.realignment_note: Texas Tech remains in the Big 12; changes in Big 12 membership during the window may still alter competition.

schools.coaching_change: Paul Johnson announced he would step down as football head coach in November 2018, during the first adidas season.
schools.realignment_note: No main-conference change in the available case seasons.
